intro: The Criminal Element involves striking against the Highlands Bandits and their leader, "Badwind" Bennic, who operate out of a concealed cave behind a waterfall in the Shen'dar Highlands. With local forces overwhelmed by the recent arrival of a menacing cult, outside help is required to eliminate Bennic and disrupt the outlaw gang.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There's a cave not far to the north, hidden behind a waterfall. It's well known to me that there's a group of bandits that are operating out of that cave. They were a problem for us before the cult arrived, but now they are a real terror. I can't spare the people to go and clear them out, unfortunately.
I need you to go there and take care of them for me. Kill as many as you can, and if possible, take out their leader, the one they call "Badwind" Bennic. That cave is dangerous, so be careful.

clips.title: Completion
paras: With the bandits dispersed, that is one less problem for us to deal with. Though I confess that now I worry that any bandits who survived may turn next to the cult for protection, further bolstering their increasingly alarming numbers.
Still though, we'll take the victories where we can get them.
